facts.title: ci: drop the aggregator job; the required checks name the jobs directly
facts.body: Recorded review of a bounded repository change. Original identifying metadata removed.
facts.author: contributor

diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index b355f6a..b01089f 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -30,34 +30,6 @@ jobs:
       project_ref: v1
       check_name: checks
 
-  all-checks-passed:
-    name: ci / all-passed
-    needs: [floor, ruff, shellcheck]
-    if: always()
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    steps:
-      - name: Require every dependency to have succeeded (a job skipped on a mechanical PR is satisfied)
-        env:
-          RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
-          MECHANICAL: ${{ needs.floor.outputs.mechanical }}
-          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
-        run: |
-          set -euo pipefail
-          # A skipped job is satisfied on a mechanical PR (the floor skipped
-          # it) and on any non-PR event (a push to the default branch, where
-          # any job skipped by its own `if:` is not a PR's failure); on a
-          # functional PR a skipped job is a failure.
-          bad="$(jq -r --arg mech "$MECHANICAL" --arg event "$EVENT" '
-            to_entries[]
-            | select(.value.result == "failure" or .value.result == "cancelled"
-                     or (.value.result == "skipped" and $mech != "true" and $event == "pull_request"))
-            | .key' <<<"$RESULTS")"
-          if [[ -n "$bad" ]]; then
-            echo "required job(s) not satisfied: $bad"
-            exit 1
-          fi
-          echo "all checks passed (event=${EVENT} mechanical=${MECHANICAL:-false})"
-
   ruff:
     name: ci / ruff
     needs: [floor]

 ## CI
 
-`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, required via the "Protect main" ruleset through `all-checks-passed`: the organization's shared `floor` job, plus this repo's own `ruff` (Python lint) and `shellcheck` (`ludeeus/action-shellcheck`, no-op today — no `.sh` files yet, kept for when scripts are added). PR-time secret scanning is the trusted lane's `trusted-scan` (`gate.yml`), a separate required check.
+`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, required via the "Protect main" ruleset: the organization's shared `floor` job (`ci / checks`), plus this repo's own `ruff` (`ci / ruff`, Python lint) and `shellcheck` (`ci / shellcheck`, `ludeeus/action-shellcheck`, no-op today — no `.sh` files yet, kept for when scripts are added). The ruleset requires each job's check directly; a new job needs its check added to the ruleset in project's `rulesets/default-branch.json`. PR-time secret scanning is the trusted lane's `trusted-scan` (`gate.yml`), a separate required check.
 
 ## Conventions

safety.name: safety
checked: Secret-scan coverage: the floor's receipt shows `trusted-scan / trusted-scan` succeeded on head 0682d5d, which runs gitleaks over the PR diff. The only file in the delta is `GUIDE.md`, and a skim of its one changed hunk (line 40) found no key-, token- or credential-shaped content. This would have caught a secret committed in the doc edit.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

works-and-proven.name: works-and-proven
checked: Compared the documented check names in the delta (`GUIDE.md:40`) with the job `name:` values in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` at head 0682d5d. The docs list `ci / checks` (floor job `name: ci` + `check_name: checks`), `ci / ruff` and `ci / shellcheck`, and the workflow produces exactly those. This would have caught docs naming a check the workflow no longer reports, such as a leftover mention of `all-checks-passed` or `ci / all-passed`, or a wrong composite name for the floor job.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

principal-engineer.name: principal-engineer
checked: Compared the reviewed head e5ee16d with head 0682d5d (only `GUIDE.md` changed) and read `GUIDE.md:40` at the head sha. This would have caught the R1-F1 stale reference to `all-checks-passed` still being there, or a new wrong description of the gate. The line no longer names the aggregator. It now describes the gate as each job's check, required directly.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

maintainable-no-slop.name: maintainable-no-slop
checked: Compared the delta `e5ee16d...0682d5d` (GUIDE.md only) and read `GUIDE.md:40` at the head sha against `.github/workflows/ci.yml` at the head sha. Each check name the guide gives must match what the workflow reports: `floor` job `name: ci` plus `check_name: checks` gives `ci / checks`, and the other two jobs are `ci / ruff` and `ci / shellcheck`. This would have caught comment drift, where the rewritten guide names a check or job the workflow does not report.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.
